Name: EasyChests - Portable Categorized Warehouse
Author: lljxww
Description:
[center][size=6][b]EasyChests[/b][/size]
[size=4]Portable Categorized Warehouse · 便携分类仓库[/size]
By lljxww | Version 0.27.4 | English / 简体中文[/center]

[size=5][b]English[/b][/size]

Spend less time sorting chests. Press [b]G[/b] to open your warehouse anywhere, or [b]V[/b] to put away backpack items. Search your stock, keep supplies on hand, craft from storage and connect your machines with optional Automate terminals.

[b]Requires Stardew Valley 1.6.15+ and SMAPI 4.1.10+.[/b] Supports single-player, multiplayer and split-screen with keyboard/mouse. English and Simplified Chinese are included. Controller navigation is unsupported.

[size=4][b]Install and start playing[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url], close the game and back up your save.
[*]Create [b]Mods/EasyChests[/b] in the game folder. Extract the contents of [b]EasyChests-0.27.4.zip[/b] directly into it, with manifest.json and EasyChests.dll directly inside that folder.
[*]Launch through SMAPI, load your save and press [b]G[/b]. A short introduction helps you get started; the [b]?[/b] button opens the full guide.
[*]When updating, replace the mod files and keep your own [b]config.json[/b]. Install only one copy. No separate runtime or chest/backpack mod is required.
[/list]
You can add EasyChests to an existing save. Automate and the other integrations below are optional; the warehouse works on its own.

[size=4][b]Find and organize your items[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]12 broad browse views[/b] keep navigation short. [b]Detailed[/b] retains all 89 original categories, inventories, purchases and favorites; no item migration is required. Broad views also find items temporarily stored in Miscellaneous.
[*][b]72 slots per page[/b], with storage expanding as needed and no fixed warehouse capacity. EasyChests does not expand your backpack or ordinary chests, but supports purchased Bigger Backpack slots.
[*][b]All Items[/b] opens by default. Search by item name, ID or category, filter by processing use, and locate an item's original category. Locked-category items and unrecognized mod items go to Miscellaneous/Mod Items.
[*][b]Favorite categories[/b] become shortcut tabs. Bookmark items for quick access, with quality stars and quantities visible throughout the warehouse.
[*][b]Refill existing items, sort a category or sort the warehouse.[/b] Search and filtered results let you work with the same stored items directly.
[/list]

[size=4][b]Make your own categories[/b][/size]
Choose [b]Categories → New Category[/b], name the view, choose an item icon and combine [b]tags, game categories, seasons or specific items[/b]. Select any/all matching and preview before saving. Left-click an item to include it; right-click to exclude it. Exclusions take priority, then explicit inclusions, then automatic conditions. An empty category matches nothing.

Installed item mods supply their tags and category names, including herb/spice tags when provided. Stable tags match future items automatically; category-name overrides add the current item set and should be selected again after new items are added. No additional compatibility mod is required. Missing item mods leave the saved rules intact but unmatched.

Select a stack and choose [b]Item → Categories[/b] to add it to a saved category. Right-click a custom card to edit it, or star it for a shortcut. Rules are personal and saved with your player. Multiple views share the same original stacks; withdrawing in one updates the others. Deleting a category keeps every item. Storage, gold unlocks, automatic material use and protection rules remain unchanged.

For a herbs/spices view, select [b]herb_item[/b] and [b]spice_item[/b] with [b]Match any condition[/b]; Match all requires every condition on one item. Multi-season crops match every growing season. First opening builds the installed item catalog and may pause briefly; later searches reuse the preview. Scroll over the list or use PageUp/PageDown. Esc leaves text focus before going back; Cancel discards unsaved edits.

[b]Updating an existing save:[/b] close the game, back up your save, replace the mod files and keep config.json. No stock withdrawal or category repurchase is needed. Original storage remains under Detailed, including the original four basic free categories and Community/Museum storage. Free browse/custom views do not purchase locked storage. Missing mod tags and icons keep their saved rules; restoring the item mod makes those rules available again.

[size=4][b]Deposit less, carry what you need[/b][/size]
Press [b]V[/b] to deposit eligible backpack items. Tools, terminals and items marked [b]Carry All[/b] stay with you. Optional toolbar protection keeps the first 12 slots with you too.

Select an item and choose [b]Carry[/b] to set a target quantity. Deposits store only the surplus; [b]Refill Carry[/b] retrieves available stock until you reach your target or your backpack is full. The target counts all stacks and qualities of that item together.

[b]Auto Deposit is off by default.[/b] Enable it to put items away when your purchased backpack space is almost full. It follows your carry/toolbar rules and never sells items.

[size=4][b]Craft, cook and build from storage[/b][/size]
Use ordinary warehouse stock for [b]crafting, cooking, Clint's tool upgrades, Robin's buildings and upgrades, and the beach bridge[/b]. The game still controls gold, recipes, required tools, placement and waiting times. Backpack and other vanilla material sources are used first.

Crafting/cooking materials are enabled by default and can be disabled in [b]Settings → Materials[/b]; this also controls tool-upgrade materials. Construction has its own switch. The first crafting/cooking menu shows a one-time notice about possible brief stutters; left-click [b]Confirm[/b] to continue.

[b]Protected Storage and Community/Museum storage are excluded[/b] from automatic material use, carry refill and Automate. Place items in Protected Storage when you want to save them for later. You can still withdraw or ship them yourself. Bookmarks are shortcuts, not protection from consumption.

[size=4][b]Collect bundle and museum items when you need them[/b][/size]
Click [b]Bundles[/b] or [b]Museum[/b] in the main action bar to take currently needed items straight into your backpack. Bundle quantities and quality requirements are respected; museum collection takes one of each eligible item. Already-carried items count first, and anything that does not fit stays stored.

Collection happens only when requested, with no automatic reservations. You stay in the warehouse; open [b]Result details[/b] or the checklist if you want to review shortages. You still submit bundles and donate items yourself. Collected items follow your normal carry/deposit rules afterward.

[size=4][b]Optional automation: give each terminal a job[/b][/size]
With [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate 2.6.1+[/url], buy a [b]Portable Warehouse Terminal for 2,500g[/b] under Settings → Deposit and place it beside your machines. Terminals use their placer's personal warehouse, or the farm's shared warehouse in shared mode. Opening a warehouse pauses its automation.

Right-click a placed terminal, then open [b]Settings → Materials → This Terminal: Automation[/b]. Choose a quick mode:
[list]
[*][b]Both ways:[/b] supply machines, receive products and allow warehouse shipping under the destination bin's rules. This is the default.
[*][b]Feed only:[/b] supply machines without receiving products or automatically selling warehouse stock.
[*][b]Intake only:[/b] receive machine products without supplying machines or selling warehouse stock.
[/list]
The three switches can also be adjusted individually. Switching modes keeps your product selection. Use [b]Shipping lists / groups[/b] below the warehouse shipping switch to choose a shipping bin and edit its products, common groups or saved categories. Returning preserves the terminal input search, filter and position. The list labeled [b]Machine input products[/b] still controls machine feeding.

[b]Choose different products for different terminals.[/b] Clear all, search by name or ID, then check only what you want to take out. For example, use separate networks for a hops-only terminal beside kegs and a vegetable-only terminal beside preserves jars. The selection controls machine feeding across qualities; intake accepts eligible products independently. Shipping uses a separate list for each destination bin.

[b]To sell machine products without storing them:[/b] choose Feed only and connect an [b]empty ordinary buffer chest plus a mini-shipping bin[/b] to the same network. Automate puts products in the ordinary chest, then moves them to the mini bin. Open [b]Shipping Bin → Auto ship[/b], select that mini bin, check the products it may receive and enable automatic shipping. Its list also filters ordinary containers in the network.
[code]Warehouse terminal (Feed only) -> machines -> ordinary product chest -> mini-shipping bin[/code]

[list]
[*]For separate jobs, use [b]separate connected networks[/b]. Terminals in one network combine their allowed products for each enabled operation, using the same warehouse stock.
[*]Selections and switches stay with each terminal when picked up and placed again. Differently configured terminals do not stack together.
[*][b]Select all / Clear all[/b] affects every product, including search-hidden items. Clear all also blocks future products until you allow them.
[*]Personal-mode players edit their own terminals; shared-mode settings are host-only. Open the placed terminal directly to configure it; G does not select a terminal.
[*]Machine permissions and reserves still apply. Manual withdrawal, manual shipping and crafting use their normal rules.
[/list]

[b]Configure each shipping bin separately.[/b] Open Shipping Bin → Auto ship, choose the placed bin by location and coordinates, then search and check allowed products. The first product or group selection enables the bin immediately; explicitly paused bins stay paused. Product checks and Quick select share one saved list, with the target and its switch visible in both views. From a terminal, either view also lets you switch its warehouse stock supply independently of machine feeding. Close the warehouse to resume transfers within the same Automate network. Flavored products such as Ancient Fruit Wine and Starfruit Wine have separate ingredient selections across qualities, along with jelly, pickles, juice, honey, roe, dried goods and smoked fish. Old base-item lists retain their scope until edited into specific current products. Checked only and select/clear all are available. Select all covers the full current catalog, including hidden rows; future products stay unchecked. Unconfigured bins retain their original Automate behavior and terminal shipping restrictions; editing terminal inputs preserves those old shipping limits. Mini-bin rules survive pickup, and different rules cannot stack. Only the host can edit farm/fixed island bins; personal-mode players can also edit their own mini bins. Shared mode requires the host and all edits require warehouse write access. Warehouse reserves, protected stock and terminal shipping switches still apply; manual shipping remains available.

[b]Quick select shipping products.[/b] Choose common groups such as alcohol, artisan goods, cooked food, drinks, crops, fish or animal products, or open My categories to use categories you have created. Clicking a group adds all matching products from the current shippable catalog, including products not in storage, across qualities. Existing checks remain and groups can be combined. Alcohol includes ingredient-specific wines, beer, pale ale and mead. Food means cooked dishes. Custom categories keep their existing exclusion, inclusion and tag rules. The result is a snapshot: select a group again after editing its category or adding content. Changes synchronize with the individual product checkboxes immediately. First selection starts shipping; explicitly paused bins stay paused.

[b]Control recipes and keep reserves.[/b] Open Machines on the main screen, or Settings → Materials → Vanilla Machine Settings, then choose a machine to allow/block its supported inputs, including items you do not own yet. Or select an item and open Item actions → Automation for its permissions and minimum reserve. Rules apply across qualities.

The [b]Processing queue[/b] shows current batches and waiting ingredients. Drag waiting rows to change feeding priority for that machine type, or block an ingredient with its cross button. Recipe, quantity, fuel and location requirements still apply. Ordinary chests and custom Automate factories follow their own rules.

[size=4][b]Everyday controls[/b][/size]
All Items and Bookmarks are available directly at the top, with Machines shown when Automate is available. Deposit, Stack Existing, Refill Carry, Bundles, Museum and Shipping Bin stay beside the backpack. Carry, Bookmark and Item actions are below it. Auto Deposit is under Settings → Deposit. The larger bottom status panel shows hints and results on two lines, with Result details at the right.

[list]
[*][b]G:[/b] open the warehouse or return through its menus. [b]V:[/b] deposit backpack items.
[*][b]Left-click:[/b] select an item. [b]Ctrl + left-click:[/b] move it. Swap these in Settings → Browsing → Use Ctrl to move items; the same choice applies to backpack, warehouse and Shipping Bin.
[*][b]Right-click:[/b] move one. [b]Shift + right-click:[/b] move half, rounded up. Withdrawals fill the backpack first; excess stays on the cursor when full.
[*][b]Alt / Option + left-click with an empty cursor:[/b] ship the whole clicked stack. The Shipping Bin view also supports deposits and retrieval before the overnight sale. Auto Deposit never ships items.
[*][b]Item actions:[/b] move a chosen amount or locate the selected item's original category. Left-click places held items normally.
[*][b]Ctrl + F:[/b] focus search. [b]Enter:[/b] apply input. Mouse wheel or PageUp/PageDown changes pages; Left/Right or Tab/Shift+Tab changes categories when no text input or dialog has focus.
[*][b]Esc:[/b] leave input, return through panels, then close. [b]?:[/b] open help. Hover controls for explanations.
[/list]
Settings save immediately. Choose Follow game, English or Simplified Chinese under [b]Settings → Interface[/b]. Game item and machine names use the game's own translations. Keybindings can be changed in GMCM or config.json while the game is closed.

[size=4][b]Personal storage and multiplayer[/b][/size]
New saves start with [b]personal warehouses[/b]; each player has their own stock, unlocks and machine rules. Existing shared saves stay shared. All online players need the same EasyChests version.

The host can permanently enable sharing under [b]Settings → Deposit[/b] or GMCM. [b]Back up the save, confirm, save the game, then reload that save.[/b] All personal inventories, including offline players' stock, merge into one shared warehouse. This cannot be reversed by resetting configuration. Bookmarks and carry targets remain personal.

Shared access is queued when another player is using the warehouse. Personal warehouses can be used independently. Warehouse automation runs on the host; menus pause the affected warehouse's automation. While waiting for warehouse materials, crafting/building can still use their usual sources.

[size=4][b]Optional companions[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu 1.12.0+[/url]: edit settings and keybindings from its menu.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11115]Better Crafting 2.18.0+[/url]: craft and cook from ordinary warehouse stock using the same material switch and first-use notice.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/541]Lookup Anything[/url]: hover an item and press its lookup key, F1 by default. Close the lookup to return to your warehouse view.
[/list]

[size=4][b]Save safety and help[/b][/size]
Save before quitting. Before uninstalling, [b]withdraw stored items, recover terminals and save[/b]; removing the mod does not return warehouse items to your backpack. Back up saves before changing storage mode or testing a new setup.

If G does not work, check SMAPI errors and key conflicts. If a machine will not take items, check the connected network, terminal mode and selection, unlocked category, machine permission, reserve, fuel and recipe requirements. Unknown mod items have a fallback category; custom crafting/automation systems may need separate support.

For bug reports, include versions, reproduction steps and a [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log link[/url].

[size=5][b]简体中文说明[/b][/size]

少花时间整理箱子，多花时间经营农场。按 [b]G[/b] 随时打开分类仓库，按 [b]V[/b] 一键归档背包；搜索物品、补齐随身物资、直接使用仓库材料制作，也可通过 Automate 终端连接加工机器。

[b]需要 Stardew Valley 1.6.15+ 与 SMAPI 4.1.10+。[/b] 支持单人、多人及分屏，使用键盘鼠标操作。内置英文与简体中文，默认跟随游戏语言；暂不支持手柄导航。

[size=4][b]安装与上手[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]安装 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]，退出游戏并备份存档。
[*]在游戏目录中新建 [b]Mods/EasyChests[/b]，将 [b]EasyChests-0.27.4.zip[/b] 的内容直接解压进去，确认该目录下直接包含 manifest.json 和 EasyChests.dll。
[*]通过 SMAPI 启动游戏，载入存档后按 [b]G[/b]。首次打开有简短引导，顶部 [b]?[/b] 可查看完整帮助。
[*]更新时替换模组文件，保留自己的 [b]config.json[/b]，只安装一份。无需额外安装运行时或其他箱子／背包模组。
[/list]
可以加入已有存档。Automate 及下方兼容模组均为可选依赖，不安装也能正常使用仓库。

[size=4][b]找到物品，整理库存[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]默认以[b]12 个常用大类[/b]浏览；[b]原有细分类[/b]保留全部 89 个旧分类、库存、解锁与收藏，无需搬迁物品。暂存在杂物中的作物等物品也可在对应大类找到。
[*][b]每页 72 格[/b]，库存按需扩容，没有固定仓库上限。不改变背包或普通箱子容量，可使用 Bigger Backpack 已购买的背包格。
[*]每次打开默认进入[b]所有物品[/b]。按名称、物品 ID 或分类搜索，按加工用途筛选，并定位原分类；尚未解锁分类的物品和未知模组物品暂存于杂物分类。
[*][b]收藏分类[/b]显示为快捷标签，也可收藏常用物品。各视图显示品质星标与数量，方便查找。
[*]支持[b]补入已有、整理当前分类、整理全仓[/b]。搜索和筛选结果可直接存取实际物品。
[/list]

[size=4][b]按自己的习惯创建分类[/b][/size]
进入[b]分类 → 新建分类[/b]，设置名称、物品图标，组合[b]标签、游戏类别、季节或指定物品[/b]，选择任一／全部匹配并预览。物品页左键包含、右键排除；排除优先，其次明确包含，再判断自动条件。空分类不匹配物品。

列表读取当前已安装物品 Mod 的标签和类别名称，例如它们提供的香料／草药标签。稳定标签规则会自动匹配未来新增物品；仅修改类别名称的分组按当前物品集合保存，新增物品后需再次选择。无需额外兼容模组；未安装相关物品 Mod 时，规则保留且不匹配缺失的物品。

选中堆叠后，通过[b]物品操作 → 自定义分类[/b]加入已有分类；右键分类卡片可编辑，星标收藏为快捷入口。规则按玩家保存。同一物品可出现在多个视图，任一视图取出后数量同步；删除分类不会删除物品。存储位置、金币解锁、自动用料和保护规则继续沿用。

例如创建草药／香料分类，勾选 [b]herb_item[/b] 与 [b]spice_item[/b]，选择[b]满足任一条件[/b]；全部条件要求同一物品同时符合每条规则。多季作物匹配每个生长季节。首次打开会建立当前物品目录，可能短暂等待，后续搜索复用预览。滚轮在列表内滚动，也可用 PageUp/PageDown 翻页；Esc 先退出文本焦点再返回，取消不保存本次编辑。

[b]旧存档升级：[/b]退出游戏并备份存档，替换模组文件、保留 config.json，无需取出库存或重新购买分类。「原有细分类」保留原库存与四个基础免费分类，以及社区／博物馆库存。免费浏览和自定义分类不会解锁付费库存。缺失物品模组的标签及图标规则继续保存，重新安装对应模组后可再次使用。

[size=4][b]一键归档，保留随身物资[/b][/size]
按 [b]V[/b] 归档背包中可存入的物品，工具、仓库终端和设为[b]全部随身[/b]的物品保留。还可开启工具栏保护，保留前 12 格物品。

选中物品后使用[b]随身[/b]设置目标数量。归档只存入超出部分，[b]补齐随身[/b]则从普通仓库补到目标数量，背包满或库存不足时停止。同种物品的不同品质、不同堆叠合计计算。

[b]自动入库默认关闭。[/b] 开启后，已购买背包空间接近满时自动归档，继续遵守随身与工具栏保护规则，不会自动出售物品。

[size=4][b]直接使用仓库材料制作与建造[/b][/size]
普通库存可用于[b]制作、烹饪、克林特工具升级、罗宾建造／升级建筑以及海滩修桥[/b]。金币、配方、所需工具、建筑放置及等待时间仍遵循游戏规则，优先使用背包和原版允许的材料来源。

仓库制作／烹饪用料默认开启，可在[b]设置 → 用料[/b]关闭，同时影响工具升级；建造有独立开关。首次打开制作／烹饪菜单会提示可能出现短暂卡顿，左键点击[b]确认[/b]后继续，之后不再重复提示。

[b]不消耗、社区与博物馆库存不参与自动用料、随身补齐和 Automate。[/b] 想留存的物品请放入「不消耗」分类，仍可主动取出或出货。物品收藏只是查找入口，不会阻止材料消耗。

[size=4][b]需要时，一键取出献祭与捐赠物品[/b][/size]
在主界面操作栏点击[b]献祭品[/b]或[b]博物馆[/b]，按当前未完成需求将匹配物品取到背包。献祭遵守数量与品质要求，博物馆每种可捐赠物品取一件；先计入背包已有物品，放不下的部分留在仓库。

只在主动操作时检索，不自动保留物品。取出后留在主界面，需要时打开[b]结果详情[/b]或清单查看短缺；献祭和捐赠仍需亲自完成。取出的物品之后遵循正常随身／归档规则。

[size=4][b]可选自动化：让每个终端各司其职[/b][/size]
安装 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate 2.6.1+[/url] 后，可在「设置 → 归档」花 [b]2,500 金购买仓库终端[/b]，放在加工机器旁组成网络。个人模式使用放置者的仓库，共享模式使用全农场仓库；打开仓库时暂停对应库存的自动化。

右键已放置终端，进入[b]设置 → 用料 → 本终端自动化[/b]，可一键选择：
[list]
[*][b]双向存取：[/b]向机器供料、收取产物，并按目标出货箱规则允许仓库自动出货，默认采用此模式。
[*][b]只供料：[/b]向机器提供原料，不收取产物，也不自动出售仓库物品。
[*][b]只入库：[/b]只收取机器产物，不供料、不出售仓库物品。
[/list]
三个开关也可单独调整，切换模式会保留产品勾选。仓库自动出货开关下方的[b]出货名单／快捷勾选[/b]可直接选择出货箱，设置具体产品、常用分组或已保存的自定义分类；返回保留终端投料搜索、筛选与列表位置。下方[b]机器投料产品[/b]仍用于机器供料。

[b]不同终端可选择不同产品。[/b] 先取消全选，再按名称或 ID 搜索并勾选所需物品。例如两个独立网络分别放置只允许啤酒花的终端与小桶、只允许蔬菜的终端与罐头瓶。勾选仅设置机器投料产品，跨品质共用；产物入库单独控制。自动出货使用各目标出货箱的独立名单。

[b]想让产物不入库、直接出售：[/b]选择「只供料」，在同一网络连接[b]空的普通中转箱和迷你出货箱[/b]。Automate 先把机器产物放进普通箱，再移入迷你出货箱。再进入[b]出货箱 → 自动出货[/b]，选择该迷你箱，勾选允许接收的产物并开启自动出货；名单也会筛选同网络的普通容器。
[code]仓库终端（只供料） -> 加工机器 -> 普通产物中转箱 -> 迷你出货箱[/code]

[list]
[*]需要独立分工时，请使用[b]不同的连通网络[/b]；同一网络会合并对应操作已开启终端的勾选，共用同一份仓库库存。
[*]每个终端独立保存设置，回收再放置仍保留；设置不同的终端不会堆叠合并。
[*][b]全选／取消全选[/b]作用于全部产品，包括搜索隐藏项；取消全选也会阻止以后新增的产品，直到主动允许。
[*]个人模式只能设置自己放置的终端，共享模式仅房主可修改。请右键实体终端配置；按 G 打开时未指定终端。
[*]机器权限与最低保留量仍生效；手动取出、手动出货和制作用料照常。
[/list]

[b]每只出货箱单独配置。[/b] 从「出货箱 → 自动出货」按地点与坐标选择已放置的箱子，搜索并勾选允许进入的产品。首次勾选产品或选择分组即开启该箱出货，主动暂停的箱子保持暂停。物品名单与快捷勾选共用一份名单，两页均显示目标箱与开关；通过终端进入时也可直接调整仓库出货开关，与机器投料独立。关闭仓库界面后在同一 Automate 网络中执行转移。上古水果果酒、杨桃果酒等加工品按原料分别勾选，所有品质共用，也覆盖果酱、腌菜、果汁、花蜜、鱼籽、干货和熏鱼。旧版基础物品名单保留原范围，首次编辑时转换为当前具体产品；支持只看勾选项与全选／取消全选。全选覆盖完整当前目录及搜索隐藏项，以后新增产品仍不勾选。未配置的箱子保留原 Automate 行为和终端出货限制；修改终端投料清单会保留原出货范围。迷你箱回收再放置保留规则，规则不同不会堆叠。农场及姜岛固定出货箱由房主配置，个人模式还允许迷你箱所有者编辑自己的箱子；共享模式仅房主可编辑，均需仓库写入访问。仓库最低保留量、隔离库存和终端出货开关仍生效，手动出货照常。

[b]快捷勾选出货物品。[/b] 可选择酒类、工艺品、食品（料理）、饮品、农作物、鱼类、动物产品等常用分组，或在「我的分类」中选择已创建的自定义分类。点击后按当前完整可出货目录追加勾选，包括尚未入库的产品，覆盖全部品质；保留已有勾选，可连续组合多个分组。酒类包含按原料区分的果酒、啤酒、淡啤酒和蜂蜜酒；食品指料理。自定义分类沿用已有的排除、包含及标签规则。勾选结果按本次快照保存，修改分类或新增内容后需再次选择；快捷勾选直接同步物品名单；首次选择即开启出货，主动暂停的箱子保持暂停。

[b]控制投料，留足存量。[/b] 从主界面「机器管理」或「设置 → 用料 → 原版机器设置」选择机器，勾选允许加工的产品，即使尚未入库也可设置；也可选中物品，通过「物品操作 → 自动化」设置其机器权限与最低保留量。最低保留量让 Automate 留出指定数量，规则跨品质共用。

[b]加工队列[/b]展示当前批次和等待原料，可拖动原料行调整同类机器的投料优先级，点击叉号禁止该原料。实际加工仍检查配方、数量、燃料与地点；普通箱子和第三方自定义 Automate 工厂遵循各自规则。

[size=4][b]常用操作[/b][/size]
主界面顶部直接打开所有物品、已收藏和机器管理（Automate 可用时显示）。归档、补入已有、补齐随身、献祭品、博物馆与出货箱集中在背包上方，随身、收藏和物品操作位于背包下方。自动入库在「设置 → 归档」开启。底部加大的状态面板分两行显示提示与操作结果，右侧可打开结果详情。

[list]
[*][b]G：[/b]打开仓库或逐层返回。[b]V：[/b]归档背包。
[*][b]左键：[/b]选中物品。[b]Ctrl + 左键：[/b]移动物品。可在「设置 → 浏览 → 移动物品使用 Ctrl」交换，背包、仓库与出货箱使用相同偏好。
[*][b]右键：[/b]移动 1 件。[b]Shift + 右键：[/b]移动半堆，向上取整。取出优先进入背包，满包余量留在手上。
[*][b]空手时 Alt / Option + 左键：[/b]整堆出货。也可在出货箱视图存入或于隔夜出售前取回；自动入库不会出货。
[*][b]物品操作：[/b]移动指定数量，或定位物品原分类。手持物品时左键正常放置。
[*][b]Ctrl + F：[/b]聚焦搜索。[b]Enter：[/b]应用输入。滚轮或 PageUp/PageDown 翻页；未聚焦输入或弹窗时，左右键或 Tab/Shift+Tab 切换分类。
[*][b]Esc：[/b]退出输入、逐层返回后关闭。[b]?：[/b]查看帮助。悬停控件可查看说明。
[/list]
设置修改立即保存。「设置 → 界面」可选跟随游戏、English 或简体中文；游戏物品和机器名称使用游戏自身翻译。按键可在 GMCM 或退出游戏后编辑 config.json 修改。

[size=4][b]个人仓库与多人游戏[/b][/size]
新存档默认[b]个人仓库[/b]，每位玩家独立拥有库存、解锁与机器规则，旧版共享存档保持共享。所有在线玩家应安装相同版本。

房主可在[b]设置 → 归档[/b]或 GMCM 永久开启共享。[b]先备份存档，确认后保存游戏，再重新载入该存档。[/b] 所有个人库存（包括离线玩家）合并到共享仓库；重置配置不能撤销。物品收藏与随身规则仍为个人设置。

共享仓库使用时其他玩家排队等待，个人仓库可分别使用。仓库自动化由房主执行，打开菜单时暂停对应库存的自动化；等待仓库材料期间，制作和建造仍可使用原有来源。

[size=4][b]可选搭配[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu 1.12.0+[/url]：通过菜单修改设置与按键。
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11115]Better Crafting 2.18.0+[/url]：在其制作和烹饪菜单中使用普通仓库材料，沿用相同用料开关与首次提示。
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/541]Lookup Anything[/url]：悬停物品并按查询键（默认 F1），关闭查询后返回原仓库界面。
[/list]

[size=4][b]存档安全与问题反馈[/b][/size]
退出前正常保存。[b]卸载前请取出仓库物品、回收终端并保存[/b]，删除模组不会自动把库存退回背包。切换仓库模式或尝试新配置前，请备份存档。

G 无法打开时检查 SMAPI 报错与按键冲突。机器不投料时，依次检查网络连接、终端模式与勾选、分类解锁、机器权限、保留量、燃料和配方要求。未知模组物品有杂物分类兜底，自定义制作／自动化系统可能需要单独兼容。

反馈问题请附版本、复现步骤与 [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI 日志链接[/url]。
